item_ancient_amulet.name: ancient amulet
item_ancient_amulet.description: A heavy amulet made of an unknown black metal, set with a dull, unblinking gem.

item_broken_stylus.name: broken stylus
item_broken_stylus.description: An intricate stylus made of bone, now broken in two.

item_burnt_scroll.name: burnt scroll
item_burnt_scroll.description: A fragile scroll, mostly destroyed by fire and time. Only a few cryptic symbols remain legible.

item_coiled_rope.name: coiled rope
item_coiled_rope.description: A length of sturdy hemp rope, coiled neatly.

item_crystal_shard.name: crystal shard
item_crystal_shard.description: A sharp shard broken off from a larger crystal formation.

item_driftwood.name: piece of driftwood
item_driftwood.description: A smooth piece of wood, worn by the sea and sand.

item_dubious_cargo.name: dubious cargo
item_dubious_cargo.description: A small, locked chest containing unknown contents. It looks valuable but likely stolen.

item_emerald.name: emerald
item_emerald.description: A stunning deep green gemstone, though it has a few minor flaws.

item_forest_berries.name: forest berries
item_forest_berries.description: A handful of wild berries growing along the path. They look edible.

item_frostpetal.name: frostpetal bloom
item_frostpetal.description: A rare alpine flower that thrives in cold, sheltered places. Said to have potent restorative properties.

item_glowing_crystal.name: glowing crystal
item_glowing_crystal.description: A fist-sized crystal that emits a faint blue glow. It feels warm to the touch and seems to pulse with an inner light.

item_gold_nugget.name: gold nugget
item_gold_nugget.description: A small, rough nugget of pure gold, likely missed by the original miners.

item_guano.name: pile of guano
item_guano.description: A large pile of bat droppings. Smells awful, but might be useful as fertilizer.

item_healing_potion_small.name: small healing potion
item_healing_potion_small.description: A small vial containing a red liquid that can heal minor wounds.

item_living_rock.name: living rock
item_living_rock.description: A piece of stone that hums with a faint inner energy.

item_lizard_scale.name: large scale
item_lizard_scale.description: A tough, greenish scale, likely shed by a large lizard.

item_mana_potion_small.name: small mana potion
item_mana_potion_small.description: A small vial containing a swirling blue liquid that restores a minor amount of mana.

item_muddy_brooch.name: mud-covered brooch
item_muddy_brooch.description: A fancy brooch, caked in thick mud. If cleaned, it might be quite valuable.

item_obsidian_chunk.name: obsidian chunk
item_obsidian_chunk.description: A piece of sharp, black volcanic glass.

item_old_campfire.name: old campfire ashes
item_old_campfire.description: The cold ashes of a small campfire.

item_old_coin.name: ancient coin
item_old_coin.description: A tarnished silver coin bearing unfamiliar markings. It appears to be very old and might be valuable to a collector.

item_pitchfork.name: pitchfork
item_pitchfork.description: A sturdy pitchfork used for moving hay.

item_pumpkin.name: large pumpkin
item_pumpkin.description: A heavy orange pumpkin, good for carving or cooking. Might provide some sustenance.

item_ripe_apple.name: ripe apple
item_ripe_apple.description: A crisp, juicy red apple, freshly picked.

item_rusty_lantern.name: rusty lantern
item_rusty_lantern.description: An old iron lantern, rusted and without fuel.

item_sharp_flint.name: sharp flint
item_sharp_flint.description: A piece of flint with a naturally sharp edge. Could be used as a makeshift tool or weapon.

item_stone_fragment.name: carved stone fragment
item_stone_fragment.description: A piece of stone broken from a larger structure, bearing part of an intricate carving.

item_strange_feather.name: strange feather
item_strange_feather.description: A large, iridescent feather unlike any bird you know.

item_summit_offering.name: weathered offering
item_summit_offering.description: A small, carved stone left at the shrine long ago. It feels strangely peaceful to hold.

item_swamp_fungus.name: pale fungus
item_swamp_fungus.description: A cluster of pale, rubbery fungi growing on a rotting log. It looks vaguely unwholesome.

item_torn_map.name: torn map
item_torn_map.description: A torn piece of parchment showing a partial map of the region. There appears to be a marked location deep in the forest, but part of the map is missing.

item_waterlogged_pouch.name: waterlogged pouch
item_waterlogged_pouch.description: A small leather pouch, soaked through but seemingly intact. Perhaps something valuable remains inside.

item_wild_herbs.name: wild herbs
item_wild_herbs.description: A bundle of fragrant wild herbs. Might be useful for cooking or alchemy.

item_wool_tuft.name: tuft of wool
item_wool_tuft.description: A small tuft of sheep's wool caught on the fence.
